files.source: same-path VFS override of 3360676953/common/on_action/xx_gptc_on_action_replace.txt (Royal Court Event Pack). Only the 103 gptc_hold_court.* entries (weights, grouping comments, order, conditions) are preserved; RC's 78-entry vanilla/hold_court base list is removed.
files.hash_note: These RC and AGOT selector hashes were recorded during independent validation on 2026-08-29 as baselines for future checks. No pre-build pins were supplied for them, so they do not prove historical non-modification before that date.
files.override_type: full-file override (identical virtual path; this mod loaded last => its file wins)
files.note: This mod ships common/on_action/xx_gptc_on_action_replace.txt with the SAME virtual path as Royal Court Event Pack's file. Because this mod is loaded LAST in the playset, CK3's full-file override rule (same path + same filename => the mod lower in the playset wins) makes THIS copy the effective file. CK3 still APPENDS random_events across the separate same-key definitions, so AGOT's common/on_action/activities/hold_court_on_actions.txt (75 active entries, incl. agot_hold_court.1001/.1011, five IDs kept disabled) merges with this gptc-only file (103 entries). Effective pool = 75 AGOT + 103 gptc = 178. RC's original 78-entry vanilla base is NOT loaded (replaced), so the five AGOT-disabled IDs are not reintroduced. This is a genuine VFS override, not a same-key final-definition and not a residual limitation.
